llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define scroll-vs-swipe arbitration with `react-native-gesture-handler` by creating a `Gesture.Native()` scroll gesture and wiring it to row pan via explicit external-gesture relation APIs (for example `simultaneousWithExternalGesture` or `requireExternalGestureToFail`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No Gesture.Native() scroll gesture is created and no simultaneousWithExternalGesture or requireExternalGestureToFail calls are present anywhere in the file.
evidence: No import of Gesture or GestureDetector

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement swipe handling with `Gesture.Pan()` and `GestureDetector` using current builder callbacks (`onBegin`/`onUpdate`/`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses legacy PanGestureHandler with onGestureEvent/onHandlerStateChange callbacks instead of Gesture.Pan() with GestureDetector and onBegin/onUpdate/onEnd builder callbacks.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Pan `onUpdate` must bound horizontal translation with an explicit clamp path (for example `clamp(...)` or equivalent min/max logic) before assigning the row translate shared value.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: In onGestureEvent, translateX.value is assigned directly from event.translationX with no clamp, Math.min/max, or any bounding logic.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure `Gesture.Pan().activeOffsetX(...)` with explicit numeric thresholds so horizontal movement is required before swipe activation.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: activeOffsetX is not a valid prop on PanGestureHandler; the correct Gesture.Pan().activeOffsetX() builder method is never called. activateDistanceX is not the required API.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure `Gesture.Pan().failOffsetY(...)` with explicit numeric thresholds so vertical movement fails pan and hands interaction back to scroll.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: failOffsetY (the required Gesture.Pan builder method) is never called. The code attempts failOffsetX with a syntax error and wrong axis, and this is on the legacy PanGestureHandler not the builder API.
evidence: failOffsetX={[{- PAN_FAIL_VERTICAL_PX, PAN_FAIL_VERTICAL_PX}]} — wrong prop, wrong axis, syntax error
